doc.title: Three Words
doc.notes_md:
### Key Links

- According to Eliane's Bardic Book: "Written for Her Stellar Highness Elashava's Bardic Challenge, on the occasion of Northshield Coronet Tourney and Investiture in Korsvag, May 4, AS XXXVII. Chorus tune: Anon. Sephardic song, 'Porque Llorax'. Remainder of tune and lyrics Š4/7/02 Eliane Halevy ([name withheld])"
doc.licensing_notes_md:

All lyrics and tunes written by me, or translations of existing lyrics, are copyright [name withheld] and may not be reproduced in print or in electronic format without my express (written) permission."

The tune for the chorus is in the public domain.
